items.name: Highland Cow Harvest Glass
items.blurb: Highland cows, a red barn and a mountain sunset printed in full color on glass. Glossy, vivid and made to be displayed.

items.name: Wildcats License Plate
items.blurb: Big Blue on a printed plate for the front of the car, the garage or the man cave. Ask about your team or school.

items.name: "Gather Here" Glass
items.blurb: "Gather Here With Grateful Hearts" over a cozy autumn porch scene. A warm piece for the Thanksgiving table or counter.

items.name: "Let It Snow" Snowmen Glass
items.blurb: A snowman family in plaid scarves with a glowing winter village behind them.

items.name: Christmas Village Glass
items.blurb: A snowy village square with a lit tree, lanterns and a horse-drawn sleigh. Pure Christmas card.

items.name: Printed Fall Sweatshirt
items.blurb: A full-color fall scene printed on a soft white sweatshirt. Send us any picture and we can put it on a shirt.

items.name: Winter Lantern Arrangement
items.blurb: A white wooden lantern frame filled with frosted pine, holly, berries and a red cardinal.

items.name: Magnolia & Pine Centerpiece
items.blurb: Deep red magnolias with long-needle pine and pinecones, built low for the dining table.

items.name: Holly Urn Centerpiece
items.blurb: Variegated holly, berries and pine in a white pedestal urn, topped with a plaid gift box.

items.name: Rustic Frame Fall Swag
items.blurb: A distressed wood frame with a big burlap and plaid bow and autumn florals. Hangs on a door or wall.

items.name: Harvest Plaid Wreath
items.blurb: Pumpkin-orange burlap and black buffalo plaid over black deco mesh. Bold enough to read from the street.

items.name: Give Thanks Centerpiece
items.blurb: Maple leaves, wheat, a little pumpkin and a hand-lettered "thankful" pick. Made for a table, bench or porch step.

items.name: Nutcracker Porch Pair
items.blurb: Hand-painted wooden nutcrackers in red and green, gold details and all. Sized to stand beside the front door.

items.name: Sweetheart Wreath
items.blurb: Red and white heart ribbon with curled mesh tubes. A cheerful door for February.

items.name: XOXO Burlap Wreath
items.blurb: Burlap, glitter hearts and "XOXO" ribbon worked into a full, round mesh wreath.

items.name: Pastel Spring Wreath
items.blurb: Lavender, robin-egg blue, buttercup and pink. Spring in curls and bows.

items.name: Blue & White Wreath
items.blurb: Royal blue and white mesh with glittered ribbon. Ask for it in your team or school colors.

items.name: Americana Porch Swing
items.blurb: A wooden porch swing refinished in red stripes, natural wood and a starred navy back rail.
